figurative_meaning_en: Humorously referring to a brother-in-law or relative
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে তার বড়কুটুমকে নিয়ে সবসময় মজা করে।
পারিবারিক অনুষ্ঠানে বড়কুটুমের ভূমিকা সবাই উপভোগ করে।
example_sentences_in_english: He always jokes about his big relative (brother-in-law).
In family gatherings, the role of the big relative is enjoyed by everyone.
note: Refers to extended family ties in a light-hearted Bengali context
